page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note right beside the fourth line of the first paragraph block ("Hebr. 13.7."); a centred chapter heading below a rule; a large woodcut initial at the start of the final paragraph.

main_text.p: que rectori, vel ductori, sive omnibus rectoribus, regula præscribitur hæc, ut ministrantis sive ministrátium loco sint, sciantq; munus illud Ecclesiæ regendę ministrando, non dominádo, obiri. Fuerunt autem omnes Apostoli rectores, & majores. Quæris quorum rectores, quibus majores? Rectores duodecim tribuum Israëlis; omnibus à se judicandi fidelibus majores. Paulus, certè, in E-Hebr. 13.7.pistola ad Hebræos, fideles jubet memores esse τῶν ἡγουμένων qui locuti sunt sermonem Dei; inferiores Apostolis pastores eo titulo insignire non dubitans.

Itaque quocumque alio primatu Petrum anteisse contendere velint Pontificii, tantum abest ut probent præstantiâ, sive primatu, muneris fuisse superiorem, ut dispositione Dominicâ oppositum clarè commonstraverimus.
main_text.head: CAP. VII.
Solvitur argumentum Pontificiorum secundum, pro suprematu Petri, à fundamenti nuncupatione, & Domini apud Matthæum dicto, Tues Petrus & super hanc petram, &c.
main_text.p: VÆ hactenus nobis observata sunt, constantissimam Christi Domini in quæstione controversa doctrinam satis manifestam faciunt; æqualiter, nempe, potestatis & authoritatis Ecclesiasticæ jura Apostolis suis, ut ante, sic post resurrectionem concessisse. Sed quia

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorative capital "Q"; read as "Quæ" with [?]. The first word of the final paragraph is therefore given as "VÆ" with the initial letter uncertain: "[?]". Marginal note "Hebr. 13.7." placed beside the paragraph at the line "in E-". Greek words in the Hebrews quotation are partly degraded; "τῶν ἡγουμένων" is a reading of [?] form.
